definitions.gloss: endangered species; species at risk of extinction
definitions.explanation: A species in danger of dying out. A shortened form of {絶滅危惧種|ぜつめつきぐしゅ}, used in conservation and news contexts to refer to plants and animals threatened with extinction.

examples.japanese: この{鳥|とり}は{危惧種|きぐしゅ}だ。
examples.english: This bird is an endangered species.

examples.japanese: {危惧種|きぐしゅ}に{指定|してい}された{動物|どうぶつ}を{保護|ほご}する。
examples.english: We protect animals designated as endangered species.

examples.japanese: {開発|かいはつ}が{進|すす}んだ{影響|えいきょう}で、{多|おお}くの{生|い}き{物|もの}が{危惧種|きぐしゅ}となっている。
examples.english: As a result of advancing development, many creatures have become endangered species.

notes:
A short form of {絶滅危惧種|ぜつめつきぐしゅ} (literally 'feared-to-go-extinct species'). Made of {危惧|きぐ} (fear, apprehension) + {種|しゅ} (species).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危惧種|きぐしゅ}に{指定|してい}する: designate as an endangered species
- {危惧種|きぐしゅ}を{保護|ほご}する: protect an endangered species

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {希少種|きしょうしゅ}: rare species — small in number but not necessarily facing extinction.
- {絶滅種|ぜつめつしゅ}: extinct species — already died out.
